primary_insight: A published natural quantity can be rewritten by revising a construct denominator with no object in nature moving. Type specimen: NMFS FES 31 Aug 2026 rewrote 2024 striped bass catch 20,822,514 → 14,323,640 (−31.2%) while management did not immediately move.
capability_gap_identified: Current tools classify missing data (ANC), filled data (FPC), discarded channels (DCC), and diverging estimators (PDC). They do not score the privilege granted to a denominator of a published census. Remainder-Growth (effort manufacturing unnamed remainder) remains unowned.
queued_leftover: Remainder-Growth Class (RGC) — observational effort grows the unnamed remainder faster than the named set. Kill rule: saturation/rarefaction. Not minted 2026-10-07.
